description:
I'm interested in working on the Planet X and Sphere X challenges. I'm curious about space exploration, planetary science, and discovering new possibilities beyond Earth.

I'm looking for teammates who are interested in space, research, coding, data analysis, creative thinking, and problem-solving. I welcome both experienced participants and beginners who are passionate about learning and teamwork.

Let's work together, share innovative ideas, and create something amazing! 🌌
summary:
Planet X – Exploring the Changing Universe

Planet X is an interactive, public-facing web platform designed to make NASA's SPHEREx space mission data easier for everyone to explore and understand. It allows users to view sky images captured at different times and compare them to discover changes in celestial objects such as stars, comets, asteroids, and other fascinating objects in space.

Our platform aims to simplify complex astronomical data through a user-friendly interface, visual comparisons, and time-based exploration. By helping users notice changes in the sky, Planet X makes it easier to identify objects that move or change over time and encourages people to take part in space exploration.

This project is important because SPHEREx collects an enormous amount of valuable data that is difficult for individuals to examine manually. Planet X connects science and technology with public participation, making astronomy more accessible, interactive, and exciting for everyone.
details:
Planet X is a web-based space exploration project designed to make NASA's SPHEREx mission data easier for the public to explore.

The main goal is to help users view sky images captured at different times and compare observations to notice changes in celestial objects. The platform aims to provide a simple and user-friendly experience for exploring astronomical images.

Users will be able to explore observations, compare images from different periods, and learn how objects in the universe change over time.

The project focuses on accessibility, interactive visualization, and public participation in space science. It aims to connect technology and astronomy while encouraging students and space enthusiasts to explore the universe.

Our vision is to make complex space data easier to understand and inspire more people to participate in scientific discovery.
